result.title: Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models
result.comment: Accepted for poster presentation at STEAI 2026 (ECCV 2026 Workshop)
result.summary: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究世界模型中用终端欧氏潜距离对候选动作序列排序的可靠性，指出「路径上不出现次序反转」正是经典 self-approaching 条件，证明潜序列折线插值的锐角弯折会导致有限步候选次序反转，并以六分支实验（含零填充三维基线）验证该排序失效。
AI.relevance_reason: LVR 中也常用 latent 距离/相似度做候选筛选、假设比较或停止判断，该文提供的「无反转」几何兼容条件可供核查这类排序是否可靠，以及维度冗余对角度容量的影响；但原文面向世界模型短程规划，迁移到 VLM 推理只是可能线索。
